sections.label: The opening
sections.para: A session programme: bring a model account and a publishable spreadsheet, or use one of five examples; five prompts to a published app; a mock day; three ways to publish; the pack in a public vault.

sections.label: In short
sections.para: The premise; two requirements; no blank page; five prompts; the day; three ways to publish; the vault.

sections.label: The premise
sections.para: Let's turn your spreadsheet into an application: the event that starts the method, the market and the villager services.

sections.label: The only two requirements
sections.para: A model that can build an app, and a spreadsheet or document with dummy data, so nothing confidential and everything shareable.

sections.label: No blank page
sections.para: People arrive with the problem written down; five invented examples for anyone without one.

sections.label: Five prompts, in order
sections.para: A searchable list; add and change rows; the view I use most; remember every run; publish it and say what it is.

sections.label: A worked example
sections.para: The holiday home checklist as an app: phases, essentials first, add a step, a history of runs, an honest about.

sections.label: The day
sections.para: A timetable from welcome and live demo through two build sessions, swapping apps, the handover session, show and tell and next steps.

sections.label: Where the apps live
sections.para: Each person's own tool, a GitHub repository per participant from a template, or a team of providers that moves them on the day.

sections.label: The pack, in a vault
sections.para: Examples, prompts, event plan and converted app as a public read-only vault for Algarve Evolution's team.

sections.label: Why this creates the market
sections.para: Value on the day, and apps that break later when more people need them: the market for the region's providers.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.para: A proposal with a mock event; everything invented; the app built for the article; models change; my interest.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.para: My voice memo of 31 October and the pack in the vault.
